arguments.value: Smart RX Systems appoints A3 Development Group as its exclusive distributor in Texas for the Smart Pharm Assist Kiosk and related products, while Smart RX and A3 may handle opportunities in other states except Florida, where Smart RX can market directly. A3 must market the products, find customers, help negotiate pharmacy management and related agreements, report leads and sales, and follow company marketing policies; Smart RX provides the products, medication purchasing, installation, training, support, pharmacists, inventory/accounting support, and product recall handling. A3 is paid mainly through a share of kiosk revenue and profits: it can receive 10% of master distributor override only if the business has positive EBITDA, and also a 40% share of net income for each customer kiosk it brings in, with detailed payment timing and special rules for certain healthcare facilities. Smart RX keeps ownership of all intellectual property and trademarks, and A3 gets only a limited license to use them for marketing and support. The agreement requires confidentiality, limits copying or modifying products, and bars A3 from using confidential information to create competing products. The parties are independent contractors, not partners or agents, and each is responsible for its own expenses and liabilities. The contract lasts five years and renews yearly unless terminated for cause or with notice; after termination A3 must stop using the products and marks, pay outstanding invoices, return customer records, and can continue receiving net income from existing customer locations while they remain active. Disputes are to be negotiated first and then resolved by arbitration, with Texas law governing and courts in Orange County, Florida designated for court proceedings related to the agreement.
